user.title: Connect to Traefik
user.description: Enter the address of the Traefik API and how it is protected. Traefik's API has no credentials of its own: it is protected by a middleware in front of the api@internal service, usually basicAuth (username and password) or a forwardAuth that checks a bearer token. Plain HTTP sends credentials unencrypted; prefer HTTPS.

data_description.url: Address of the Traefik API with scheme (http or https), host and port, for example the address of the Traefik dashboard without the /dashboard/ path.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate on the Traefik API.
data_description.auth_type: How the Traefik API is protected: no authentication, basic auth or a bearer token checked by a forwardAuth middleware.
data_description.username: Username of the basicAuth middleware in front of the Traefik API.
data_description.password: Password of the basicAuth middleware in front of the Traefik API.
data_description.token: Token your forwardAuth middleware accepts; it is sent as a bearer token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Traefik
reauth_confirm.description: Traefik rejected the stored credentials. Choose how the Traefik API is protected and enter the current credentials. Traefik's API has no credentials of its own: it is protected by a middleware in front of the api@internal service, usually basicAuth (username and password) or a forwardAuth that checks a bearer token.

data_description.auth_type: How the Traefik API is protected: no authentication, basic auth or a bearer token checked by a forwardAuth middleware.
data_description.username: Username of the basicAuth middleware in front of the Traefik API.
data_description.password: Password of the basicAuth middleware in front of the Traefik API.
data_description.token: Token your forwardAuth middleware accepts; it is sent as a bearer token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Traefik
reconfigure.description: Change the address of the Traefik API, TLS verification or authentication; the integration reloads afterwards. Traefik's API has no credentials of its own: it is protected by a middleware in front of the api@internal service, usually basicAuth (username and password) or a forwardAuth that checks a bearer token. Plain HTTP sends credentials unencrypted; prefer HTTPS.

data_description.url: Address of the Traefik API with scheme (http or https), host and port, for example the address of the Traefik dashboard without the /dashboard/ path.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate on the Traefik API.
data_description.auth_type: How the Traefik API is protected: no authentication, basic auth or a bearer token checked by a forwardAuth middleware.
data_description.username: Leave empty to keep the stored username while the authentication type stays the same.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password while the authentication type stays the same.
data_description.token: Leave empty to keep the stored token while the authentication type stays the same.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Traefik. Check the URL, the network and that the API is enabled.
error.invalid_url: The URL is malformed. Use the http or https scheme and a non-empty host.
error.invalid_auth: Traefik rejected the credentials, or they contain characters that cannot be sent (a control character, or a colon in the username).
error.api_disabled: Traefik's API is not enabled. Add the api block to your Traefik static configuration.

abort.already_configured: This Traefik instance is already configured.

init.title: Traefik options
init.description: Adjust polling cadence, TLS verification, and the certificate warning threshold — URL changes use the separate Reconfigure flow.

error.scan_interval_out_of_range: Polling interval must be between 15 and 300 seconds.

auth_failed.message: Traefik rejected the credentials for {path}. Enter them again in the re-authentication dialog.

api_error.message: Reading {path} from the Traefik API failed: {detail}.

redirect.message: The Traefik API redirected {path} (HTTP {status}). The integration does not follow redirects; enter the address Traefik redirects to (for example the HTTPS address) via Reconfigure.

invalid_url.message: Home Assistant cannot send requests to the stored Traefik URL. Correct the URL via Reconfigure.

invalid_credentials.message: The stored credentials cannot be sent to Traefik. Enter them again in the re-authentication dialog.

version_unavailable.message: The Traefik version is not available yet.

no_probe_host.message: The Traefik URL has no host to check certificates at. Correct the URL via Reconfigure.

entities_migrated.title: Traefik entities were replaced
entities_migrated.description: The Traefik integration "{entry_title}" was updated. Router binary sensors were replaced by router sensors with new entity IDs (states: enabled, warning, error, disabled, missing). The reload button and the reload service were removed because Traefik has no reload API; use the "Refresh now" button instead. {removed_count} old entities were removed. Update automations, scripts and dashboards that used them, then dismiss this notice.
